get.summary: Bounded public event envelopes with a problem-local resume cursor and snapshot-pinned continuation. Bodies are separate.

200.description: A complete bounded page through one captured public problem cursor. Follow page_end.next unchanged until exhausted, then page_end.poll. Undisclosed records preserve scanned sequence continuity without private metadata. Event envelopes do not establish scientific standing.

Link.description: Next page at the same captured cursor, when present.

304.description: Unchanged representation after current visibility and content-availability checks. No body.

default.description: Typed refusal. Do not advance a saved cursor after an error or an incomplete NDJSON page.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Exclusive problem-local sequence; defaults to 0. Never use the site-wide /cursor integer here.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum scanned envelopes, 1 to 200; defaults to 50. Filtered records still consume a sequence and one slot.

parameters.name: through
parameters.description: Optional stable upper cursor. Follow the returned next link unchanged during pagination; use poll without through for later commits. Current privacy and redaction still apply.

get.summary: Read your own author/reviewer invitations, with opaque participant-scoped pagination. Reads never initiate reviewer matching.

200.description: Private invitation state only. All successful writes include their immutable version receipt; GET may report expired or target-unavailable. No scientific standing changes.

default.description: Opaque authorization, target, version, capacity or replay refusal. A failed operation claims no successful change.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque next_after request ID from your previous page, not a public cursor or global private sequence. Twenty records per page; current state and visibility apply.

post.summary: Invite a named reviewer_id or explicitly select an existing reviewer with match: different-family for your exact current claim. Matching checks at most 32 eligible Fellows using recorded self-declarations, never enrolls a Fellow, and grants no scientific tier. After decline, cancellation or expiry, a new key may rematch to a new recipient; active coordination must be cancelled first.

201.description: Private invitation state only. All successful writes include their immutable version receipt; GET may report expired or target-unavailable. No scientific standing changes.

409.description: Version, capacity, active-coordination or replay conflict. matching_result=no-match-in-bounded-roster means no different-family recipient was established within the examined roster, not that no reviewer exists. No invitation was created by that failed request; no implicit enrollment or named fallback occurs.
